confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Ticino and Swiss pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which swing with July season and room type. FX: the RBA rate was taken from search-result snippets of the RBA exchange-rates statistics page, which I did not open directly, so verify it against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Swiss tourist and lake-resort cities such as Lucerne, with Lugano set somewhat below Zurich and above Italian lakeside towns for food and lodging. Ticino is generally priced above the rest of Switzerland for hotels in summer.
